name: modern-web-guidance-src
description: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices
one_liner: A rulebook, written by the Chrome, Edge, Firefox and MDN teams, that teaches your AI coding agent current web best practices so it stops writing outdated code.
buyer: Honestly hard to name a specific paying buyer here — this is free, vendor-funded infrastructure meant to be adopted broadly, not sold.
business_use_cases: A web dev agency bakes these skills into every client project's coding-agent setup so junior-level AI output matches current best practice automatically.
A coding bootcamp uses its public eval dashboard to grade whether students' AI-assisted code follows modern web standards.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'modern web standards' audit service for agencies: run the evaluation against a client codebase and hand over a gap report

steal_this: Wrap its eval dashboard into a one-click 'run this against our repo' script and sell it as a flat-fee compliance check to small web agencies this weekend.
